subject: Marketplace private offer - decision velocity and term bundling
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-15 09:12 PDT
Subject: Marketplace private offer - term bundling & approvals

Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. We are evaluating a consolidated AWS private offer that would cover two business units (Analytics and Clinical Ops). Procurement wants clarity on three things before we can move forward:

1) Recommended term structures you support (12/24/36 months) and the corresponding list price vs private-offer net pricing for each.
2) The formal buyer approval ladder Acme needs to clear for a private offer over our threshold (we typically route anything over $150k).
3) An estimate of how long Marketplace needs from signature to private-offer activation once the PO is in place.

I attached our procurement guidelines for reference (Acme_Procurement_Guidelines.pdf). We are aiming to decide by 06/30. Can you propose options and an approximate timeline?

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Health

--
Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Guidelines.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-15 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer - term bundling & approvals

Samira,

Appreciate the context and the deadline. At a high level we can support the consolidation across both BUs and here are practical, executable options tailored to typical Acme requirements:

Option A - 12 month auto-renew
- Net pricing: list minus 5%
- Standard private-offer SLA; activation target: 3-5 business days after PO entry into AWS if paperwork is complete
- Approvals needed: Procurement + Finance signoff for net pricing

Option B - 24 month term (non-cancellable)
- Net pricing: list minus 10%
- Activation target: 5-7 business days
- Approvals needed: Procurement + Finance signoff; Legal review recommended for cross-BU consolidation

Option C - 36 month term (discounted)
- Net pricing: list minus 15%
- Activation target: 7-10 business days; requires buyer signoff and a PO + SOW
- Approvals needed: Procurement, VP Finance, and Legal signoff for contract term length

Notes and risks:
- If Acme requires invoice net terms different than Marketplace defaults (e.g., net-30 vs net-60), we need to confirm that with AWS Seller Support and may require a marketplace billing exception.
- For any term >24 months we typically ask Legal to run a short review; that is the longest lead item.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Let us know which option you prefer (A/B/C) or if you want a blended structure across the two BUs.
2) Provide the list of internal approvers and any PO templates; we will prepare a consolidated private-offer draft and a one-page mutual action plan.
3) If you want an expedited path, we can prep our standard private-offer terms and loop in AWS Seller Support for activation concurrently.

I can jump on a 30-min call this afternoon if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0134

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-16 09:28 PDT
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer - term bundling & approvals

Looping Karthik here to confirm pricing floors and any finance gating. A few internal clarifications from our side:

- Pricing floor: For a bundled, cross-BU private offer we need to maintain a minimum ARR-equivalent floor of $120k to cover reserved capacity overhead. If Acme's expected spend is below that, we should default to a lighter discount band.
- SLA/reservation impact: If Acme requests reserved capacity under Dedicated for either BU, that changes activation timing and may require a separate reserved instance agreement.
- Quick path: If they can accept our standard terms (we have a template), we can often push to a 7-business-day activation with AWS support.

Marissa, can you ask Samira to share the internal approver list and any PO template? Vanessa — please stand by to draft the private-offer price sheet once we know the preferred term.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acmehealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-16 14:10 PDT
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer - term bundling & approvals

Thanks Marissa and team — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from Procurement:

- Procurement prefers Option B (24 months) but we are open to Option C if Finance signs off.
- Approval ladder for private offers > $150k at Acme is: Procurement Director -> VP Finance -> CFO. If the deal touches patient data or cross-region hosting, CISO review is required as well.
- Timeline: Procurement can turn a PO in 7 business days once terms are agreed; Legal adds 3-5 business days for a standard SOW review.

I attached our procurement checklist that shows the gating docs we will require (PO template, W9, proof of insurance).

Samira Khan
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Health

--

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: AWS Marketplace Seller Support <seller-support@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-06-17 16:55 PDT
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer - decision velocity and term bundling

Quick internal note to finalize approach before we send the private-offer draft to Acme:

1) Pricing recommendation: Prepare two lanes in the price sheet — 24m consolidated at list minus 10% (preferred) and 36m at list minus 15% if Finance gives approval. Call out minimum floor of $120k ARR.
2) Approvals: Document the approval ladder verbatim and add Legal review for cross-BU consolidation. We will include a checklist that maps Acme docs to our enablement items so procurement can tick boxes for activation.
3) Activation SLA: Offer a 7-business-day expedited activation if Acme provides PO + signed SOW and their Procurement sends the PO to AWS Seller Support with the private offer id. Otherwise default to 10 business days.

I attached our standard private-offer terms and a fillable price sheet. Once Vanessa populates the sheet I will review and then Marissa can send to Samira with a short MAP and DocuSign link.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
